binding_note: Two users share the first name 'Robert' (Robert Walsh, Robert Chen) and each authored a message asking about a pending deployment in a different channel; the request does not disambiguate which Robert is meant, so both membership+message pairs are the intended selection.

obligations.name: robert_memberships
obligations.description: Workspace membership records for the two people named Robert who each authored a message asking whether a deployment is finished; report their membership role (owner/admin/member/guest) as displayed on the pair.
obligations.scope: workspace membership of the Robert(s) identified via their deployment-status messages

obligations.name: robert_deploy_messages
obligations.description: The specific messages, one per matched Robert, that ask whether a deployment has finished; quoted alongside the membership role.

task_spec.text: Identify each person named Robert who asked, in some channel, whether a deployment was finished yet.
For each such Robert, report the workspace membership role shown on their membership pair and quote their deployment-status message.

access_plan: Use users.list (or users.info) to find users whose real_name begins with 'Robert', then use conversations.history/search.messages across their member channels (#general and #core-infra) to find messages phrased as asking whether a deployment/fix is done; for each matched user, resolve their workspace role via their user_teams membership record surfaced through users.info/team association.
